projects.name: Apollo + Slack Lead Intelligence
projects.description: Automated pipeline that captures high-intent leads from Apollo.io and delivers real-time intelligence to Slack channels for immediate sales action.
projects.longDescription: Built a scalable integration using Node.js and Apollo APIs to monitor website visitors and target accounts. When a high-intent visitor is detected, the system pulls enriched company data and notifies the relevant sales team in Slack with actionable insights.

projects.name: HubSpot Data Sync Engine
projects.description: Custom middleware for bidirectional synchronization between Amazon Seller Central and HubSpot CRM, ensuring unified customer data across all channels.
projects.longDescription: Developed a robust sync engine that captures Amazon order data, customer feedback, and return signals, mapping them directly to HubSpot contacts and deals. This provides a 360-degree view of the customer journey for the marketing and support teams.

projects.name: ScaleSmart Operations Dashboard
projects.description: Unified command center for Amazon marketplace health, inventory tracking, and VOC analysis, built for high-volume sellers.
projects.longDescription: A comprehensive internal tool that aggregates data from multiple sources to provide a real-time overview of account health, buy box wins, and inventory levels, with automated alerts for critical events.

projects.name: SpeedTalk Mobile
projects.description: Rebuilt SpeedTalk’s Amazon strategy around the Connected Camera micro-segment. Eliminated trust barriers, restructured catalog logic, and optimized ad spend to capture high-intent buyers.

projects.name: SecuLife Operations
projects.description: Unified SecuLife’s hardware, service, and support systems into a premium, Amazon-forward brand architecture. Powered by direct VOC loops guiding CX, refunds, warranty flows, and activation steps.

projects.name: WesBI Cockpit
projects.description: Transforms raw CSV dumps into actionable insights. Provides instant visibility into inventory KPIs, velocity trends, and operational risk — designed for rapid Amazon decision-making.

projects.name: Buy Box Master
projects.description: A high-speed analysis engine reading Keepa exports to detect multi-ASIN Buy Box shifts. Built for instant competitive response across SecuLife, Jolt, and SpeedTalk portfolios.
